name: Adding — Finger by Finger
summary: Build fullness one finger at a time. Fingers beat fixed-width penises/toys because they can expand, curl, and splay to press precise spots. 76% prefer gradual buildup. Includes Edge Press Swirl, Outside Press, V-Stroke, and Rotating & Splaying.

Add fingers gradually—each one deserves minutes, not seconds—waiting until fully ready for the next. Many describe the playful joy of starting small and silently begging for more as intensity builds. Four named sub-techniques shape the pressure.

2. Give each finger minutes of attention before adding the next; add only when fully ready.
3. Edge Press Swirl: with finger(s) inserted, make circular movements pushing outward around the inner walls (entrance or deeper, by preference).
4. Outside Press: for stretch without deep penetration, press a closed cone-shaped hand against the entrance to feel fullness externally first.
5. V-Stroke: with 2+ fingers, make a V pressing the side walls while pulling outward so the vagina relaxes and 'balloons' for more pressure.
6. Rotating & Splaying (Kim's technique): rotate/splay fingers at different depths and angles to stimulate cervix/back walls without uncomfortable impacts.
safety_notes: Each addition needs minutes and full readiness—never rush to more fingers.
Keep lube flowing; stop if there's any pinching or pain.
